acceptance_criteria.text: Given a Support agent with refund permission is viewing an Order that is currently paid, is a Recent order, and has not already been refunded, when the Support agent selects Refund, then the system shows a confirmation that the full paid Order total will be refunded.

Given the Refund confirmation is shown, when the Support agent submits the confirmation, then the system attempts to issue a Full-order refund for the full paid Order total exactly as captured on the Order.
Given the Refund confirmation is shown, when the Support agent closes or cancels the confirmation without submitting it, then no Refund is issued and the Order remains unchanged.
Given the Refund confirmation is shown, when the Support agent submits the confirmation, then the Support agent is not required to enter a Refund reason.

Given a Support agent with refund permission submits a Refund confirmation for an Order and that Refund completes successfully, when another Refund submission for the same Order is handled, then the same Order is not refunded a second time.

Given one Refund has completed successfully for an Order, when repeated submissions for that same Order are handled, then the Order is shown as refunded.
Given a Refund attempt fails, when the result is shown to the Support agent, then the message says “The refund could not be completed. Please try again.”
Given a Refund completes successfully, when the orders screen is shown to a Support agent, then the internal audit/history record is not shown on the orders screen.
